About us · من نحن

A home for learning the Book of Allah and its language.

Live online classes for children and adults across Canada, the US and beyond, taught by our own instructors. Our students have gone on to win local Qur'an competitions.

One-to-one

Private lessons, shaped around you

Your own teacher, your own pace, your own hours, and a plan written just for you.

  • Your schedule. Lessons at times that work for you, across time zones.
  • Your goals. Fix your recitation, complete a juz', prepare for a competition or start Arabic from zero.
  • Any subject. Qur'an reading, Tajwid, Hifdh, Arabic or Islamic studies.
  • Every age. Children, teens and adults; families can learn together.
